items.detail: The **S&P 500** rose 0.51% to **7,743.41** on Friday and the Nasdaq added 0.5% to 27,068.72, both ending a volatile week higher.
items.why: Oil retreated on hopes the Strait of Hormuz reopens, and the four-day bond selloff finally paused.

items.detail: The **10-year Treasury yield** ended Friday little changed at **5.16%**, halting four straight days of heavy selling.
items.why: October Fed hike odds eased to 66% from about 75% ahead of Wednesday's PCE and Friday's jobs report.

items.detail: **Microsoft** rose 3%, the S&P 500's biggest single boost, as Meta capped a week-long AI rally.
items.why: Microsoft unveiled Copilot coding tools and an always-on AI agent, while Meta's new Muse assistant drew buyers.

items.detail: **Hong Kong's Hang Seng** fell 1.01% to **24,510**, a third straight loss, with mainland China, Korea and Taiwan shut for Mid-Autumn Festival.
items.why: Stock Connect was suspended, so mainland buying vanished and tech stocks fell with no relief from the Trump-Xi letdown.

items.detail: India's **Nifty 50** rebounded 0.34% to **23,140** on Friday after Thursday's sharp fall, led by auto and realty shares.
items.why: Cheaper oil and a steadier US bond market eased pressure, though foreign investors have sold ₹12,609 crore this month.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** rose just **0.31%** on Friday, less than half the Dow's gain, and closed at 2,844.32.
items.why: With the 10-year still near 5.16%, small caps' floating-rate debt costs stay high, so they missed the AI rally.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** slipped below **$84,000** on Saturday, down about 0.8% over 24 hours and still stuck in its weekly range.
items.why: Bitget confirmed $387.5 million of stolen assets, the year's biggest crypto hack, keeping buyers cautious over the weekend.

items.detail: **Ether** steadied near **$2,691**, roughly flat over 24 hours, snapping the three-day slide that took it to $2,647 on Thursday.
items.why: October Fed hike odds falling to 66% took some pressure off the riskiest corners of crypto.

items.detail: **Solana** climbed to about **$119**, roughly 3% above Friday's level and back at the top of its month-long range.
items.why: Spot Solana ETFs have now drawn over $1.16 billion, with Bitwise's BSOL leading the latest inflows.

items.detail: **Spot gold** rose about 0.4% to **$4,293 an ounce** on Friday, its first gain in five sessions.
items.why: The dollar slipped from a two-month high and bond yields steadied, giving bullion room to bounce.

crossCuttingTheme: The bond selloff paused on Friday — the 10-year held at 5.16% and October hike odds eased to 66% — letting AI megacaps rally and gold bounce, while small caps and Hong Kong still lagged.
